label: Zurich · centre, north & west
description: From Altstetten and Oerlikon through Höngg, Wipkingen and the city centre to Wiedikon and Seefeld. The dashed boundary shows the supported walking area, not the entire municipality. Building-model gaps and long shadows at the edge remain unknown.

label: Central Basel & Kleinbasel
description: An expanded central pilot spanning Basel SBB, the old town, the Rhine and more of Kleinbasel. Greenery and water proximity are available within the dashed boundary; no sun/shade recommendations yet.

label: Central Munich & adjoining districts
description: The supported area includes the old town, Hauptbahnhof, Maxvorstadt, Schwabing, Theresienwiese and Haidhausen. The dashed boundary covers 40.5 km². Building shade, elevation and mapped addresses are available within it. Tree shade and complete pavement coverage are still missing.

label: Cambridge city boundary
description: The municipal boundary now includes Harvard, Central and Kendall squares, North Cambridge and Fresh Pond. Routes stay on the Cambridge side of the boundary. Greenery uses recorded trees, not a complete canopy survey; shade is not yet enabled.

label: Old Town essentials
description: A smaller walking area around Karlsplatz, Frauenkirche and Odeonsplatz. Choose the full Munich pack for the adjoining districts. Both downloads include surrounding shadow geometry. This rectangle is a download area, not an administrative district.
